Stanbic IBTC Ethical Fund

Highlights
  • The Stanbic IBTC Ethical Fund (SIEF) was launched in January 2006
  • The Fund invests a minimum of 70% of its portfolio in equities of socially responsible companies quoted on the Nigerian Exchange Limited (NGX), and a maximum of 30% in fixed income securities 
  • The Fund has a 91-day minimum holding period
  • The penalty for redeeming within the minimum holding period is 20% on the accrued income
  • The minimum investment amount is N5,000.00 
  • The expense ratio for the Fund is 3.5%
  • It is an open ended fund 
  • The risk profile of the Fund is “Aggressive”
  • The management fee is 3.0%
